# DeiT

**Category:** ViT · **Code:**
[`timm/models/deit.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/deit.py) ·
**Architectures:** 16 · **Pretrained weights:** 24 (24 with ImageNet-1k results)

Data-efficient Image Transformers (DeiT) are Vision Transformers trained on ImageNet-1k only, optionally with a
distillation token that learns from a CNN teacher. DeiT III models are trained with an improved recipe.

## Papers

* [Training data-efficient image transformers & distillation through attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.12877)
* [DeiT III: Revenge of the ViT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.07118)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('deit_small_distilled_patch16_224.fb_in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

## Model API support

| Feature | `VisionTransformer` | `VisionTransformerDistilled` |
|---|---|---|
| [`features_only=True` feature maps](../model_api#intermediate-features) | ✓ (strides 16, 16, 16) | ✓ (strides 16, 16, 16) |
| [`forward_intermediates()`](../model_api#intermediate-features) | ✓ | ✓ |
| [`prune_intermediate_layers()`](../model_api#intermediate-features) | ✓ | ✓ |
| [Any input size, no changes needed](../model_api#input-size) | ✗ | ✗ |
| [`set_input_size()`](../model_api#input-size) | ✓ | ✓ |
| [`dynamic_img_size=True`](../model_api#input-size) | ✓ | ✓ |
| [`set_grad_checkpointing()`](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✓ | ✓ |
| [Layer-wise LR decay (`group_matcher()`)](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✓ | ✓ |
| [`reset_classifier()`](../model_api#classifier) | ✓ | ✓ |

✓ supported, ✓ (square) works for square sizes only, ✗ not supported, – not needed (the model already accepts any input
size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`VisionTransformer` with `deit_tiny_patch16_224`
at 224, `VisionTransformerDistilled` with `deit_tiny_distilled_patch16_224` at 224), other architectures of the same
class are expected to behave the same. See the [Model API](../model_api) page for details.
